- Wire: fine for international payments; please confirm beneficiary name exactly as shown below.
- Virtual card: we can accept but it typically posts faster if your AP team can process the single charge before month-end.

We can also offer a temporary escrow arrangement if internal approval cycles are blocking payment — that keeps your procurement controls intact while accelerating settlement on our side.

Attached: INV-3921.pdf and our bank_instructions_redwood.pdf.

Can you confirm preferred payment method and, if wire, the paying entity and approximate payment date? If we don’t hear back, we’ll follow up EOD local time.

Thanks — looping Ben and Jonas to help expedite if AP needs additional paperwork.

Best,
